SR148 Ferm Living (fermliving.com, DK/EU storefront, verified genuinely separate from SR73 fermliving.us per notes/148.md). Set localization=DK cookie first (same as SR73/prior pass finding). Searched collections.json (186 total collections, full page) for Clearance-family keywords (clearance/outlet/last-chance/final-sale/end-of-line/discontinued/sale) - found a whole 'Sale' tier: 'sale' (371), 'sale-accessories' (93), 'sale-furniture' (40), 'sale-holiday' (10), 'sale-kids' (69), 'sale-kitchen' (83), 'sale-lighting' (53), 'sale-green-living'/'Sale - Outdoor Living' (19), 'sale-rugs' (8), 'sale-textiles' (18). These non-zero products_count values exist ONLY in the backend collections.json/sitemap data. Fetched the actual rendered pages (/collections/sale and /collections/sale-furniture as spot checks, same theme template as all sale-* handles): both return HTTP 200 but render a themed placeholder -

Something Special is on the Horizon

This content is currently unavailable. Stay tuned, as we look forward to sharing it with you soon.

- with ZERO products actually listed (no /products/ links, no product grid). None of the sale-* URLs are linked anywhere in the homepage's live navigation markup (confirmed via regex scan of nav href attributes for sale/outlet/clearance - none present, unlike bestsellers/kids-bestsellers which ARE linked). Also probed guessed alternate URL shapes (/collections/outlet, /pages/outlet, /pages/sale) - all 404. Site search for 'outlet' returns 61 generic product-text matches (not a dedicated PLP; excluded per brief - search-results pages don't qualify). CONCLUSION: this is not a currently-accessible Clearance/Outlet PLP by any URL - the products exist in the catalogue/sitemap but the merchandising page itself is gated behind an explicit 'currently unavailable' placeholder, i.e. not live to visitors. This exactly matches SR73's (fermliving.us) finding of the identical gap ('Sale' variants + 'News'/'Kids News' all placeholder-gated) - now independently confirmed present on this separate .com/DK Shopify instance too, which suggests a deliberate, brand-wide, not-yet-launched merchandising tier rather than a one-off site glitch. Recording as no valid PLP found (empty rows) rather than fabricating rows for content that isn't actually listed to visitors; worth rechecking on a later pass in case the rollout completes.
